jobs.title: Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
The Compliance Specialist will be involved in various aspects of an ever-changing regulatory landscape within the Compliance Team of a global asset management firm. This individual will be primarily responsible for producing compliance-related reporting and working closely with internal partners to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and firm policies. This individual will also be involved in special projects as they arise. This role will work closely with senior members of the Compliance team to build out and enhance processes in alignment with regulatory expectations.

Responsibilities

The candidate can expect to:

- Prepare periodic compliance reports and attestations, as well as respond to various questionnaires and certifications

- Research and respond to internal and external compliance-related inquiries

- Draft and review compliance-related responses to RFPs

- Prepare documentation for due diligence meetings, compliance meetings and regulatory examinations

- Interpret and apply knowledge of rules and regulations to correspondence, sales literature, advertisements, institutional material, RFPs, and other types of communication to ensure compliance with applicable regulations

- Assist with the administration of the Code of Ethics and related processes

- Assist with documentation of various policies, procedures, and memos

- Assist with annual compliance testing and surveillances

- Actively participate in various compliance group projects and initiatives

- Develop working knowledge of various Artisan systems and business operations

Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Additionally, the ideal candidate will possess:

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration a plus

- 1-2 years in the financial services industry a plus

- Knowledge of equity and fixed income markets, trading practices, and related instruments

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Applications, strong Excel skills (required)

- Ability to make independent judgments and handle confidential information

- Strong written communication skills

- Ability to demonstrate resourcefulness, creativity, and initiative by identifying and implementing process enhancements

- Ability to prioritize and meet multiple deadlines with a sense of urgency

- Solid interpersonal and communication skills, including a high degree of client service-mindedness

- Experience working with Aladdin, Charles River, Bloomberg, Advent Geneva, or Tableau a plus

jobs.title: Corporate Finance Associate
jobs.description:
The Corporate Finance team supports the financial integrity of Artisan Partners, through accounting, financial reporting, analysis and financial controls.

The Corporate Finance Associate will join a collaborative team with exposure to a broad range of accounting and financial activities across the Firm. The role offers an opportunity to build a strong foundation in corporate finance while contributing to the monthly close, financial reporting and analysis, and ongoing financial operations.

In addition to core accounting responsibilities, the Associate will help advance how the team works by using data, analytics, automation and AI-enabled tools to improve processes, strengthen controls and generate meaningful financial insights. The ideal candidate brings strong accounting fundamentals, intellectual curiosity and an interest in using technology to solve problems and continuously improve the Finance function.

Responsibilities

The candidate is expected to:

- Support the monthly close process, including preparation of general ledger entries, account reconciliations and related financial analysis

- Analyze monthly financial results, identify key trends and drivers, and prepare variance analysis for presentation to management

- Reconcile cash activity, investigate anomalies and use analytical and automation tools to improve transaction matching and reconciliation processes

- Identify opportunities to automate, standardize and enhance financial processes, reporting and controls

- Partner with departments across the Firm to provide budget-to-actual reporting and analysis, including identification of meaningful trends and expense drivers

- Analyze fixed asset transactions and apply appropriate GAAP accounting treatment

- Perform calculations and analysis related to right-of-use assets and lease liabilities under ASC 842

- Support internal and external audit requests and contribute to special projects and ad hoc financial analysis

- Process and review accounts payable activity, including invoice payments and general ledger coding

- Process and review Firm credit card payments and travel expense reports

Qualifications

The successful candidate will combine strong accounting fundamentals and attention to detail with an analytical mindset and genuine interest in working with data and technology. Additionally, the ideal candidate will possess:

- 1–3 years of relevant accounting or finance experience; public accounting experience preferred

- Four-year degree in accounting with demonstrated academic achievement

- CPA or progress toward CPA designation preferred

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an interest in continuous process improvement

- Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities and exercise sound judgment

- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines

- Effective interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and functions

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including advanced Excel skills

- Exposure to at least one data or analytics tool beyond Excel, such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python, with an interest in further developing those capabilities

- Experience using large language models (LLMs) for practical applications and curiosity about applying emerging technologies within the Finance function

jobs.location: Boston, MA | Chicago, IL | Milwaukee, WI | San Francisco, CA | New York, NY | Denver, CO
jobs.description:
Artisan Partners’ Global Value team is seeking an experienced sales professional to join their dedicated distribution team. In partnership with the business leader for the Global Value team, this individual will be responsible for driving growth and raising assets in the intermediated wealth channel. This position seeks an organized, self-starter with an entrepreneurial spirit who brings a rigorous sales framework and a proven sales record to identify new business and drive growth.

Base Salary Range: $125,000 - $175,000

Specific placement within the provided range will be determined by an individual’s geographic location as well as relevant experience and skills for the role. Base salary is only one component of our total compensation package. Associates may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, which is determined upon Firm and individual performance.

Responsibilities

The candidate is expected to:

- Business Planning: Work closely with the business leader to develop and execute a go-to-market and ongoing sales plan targeted at the intermediated wealth channel

- Messaging and Positioning : Develop clear, differentiated, and client-centric messaging aimed at the needs of the intermediated wealth channel

- Strategic Prospecting: Identify an informed prospect universe leveraging personal and firm relationships, databases, and on the ground and personal networking.

- Targeted Sales: Execute on a sales plan, identify actionable prospects, and close new business opportunities

- Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with the business leader, internal teams, including senior leadership, investments, and distribution, to ensure alignment and successful execution.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Additionally, the ideal candidate will possess:

- At least 10 years of sales experience and a demonstratable sales record

- Bachelor’s degree

- FINRA Series 7 & 63 licenses

- Knowledge of financial markets, and investment products

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate / Associate Analyst
jobs.description:
Artisan Partners seeks a highly motivated, intellectually curious Senior Research Associate / Associate Analyst to join the EMsights Capital Group, the firm’s autonomous investment team. The team invests long and short across global debt and equity securities with a focus on emerging and frontier markets.

This is an exciting opportunity for an individual who is interested in researching companies in emerging, frontier and developed markets and developing skills to analyze public and private investments.

The individual will work side by side with Portfolio Managers, Analysts, and Traders to help them understand the issues driving company valuations. Research Associates contribute to the team’s investment process as they perform research into daily news events, build and maintain financial models, and interact with company management and industry experts for companies around the world. They will also be expected to conduct in-depth analysis into industry fundamentals, supply and demand, governance quality, as well as social issues and environmental concerns of their companies.

As experience is gained, the individual will be given opportunities to deepen their exposure to the idea generation and investment management processes and interact with various team members to fully explore the various roles required to manage investment portfolios.

Attendance at industry conferences and travel to visit companies under coverage will be required.

Location: Boston, MA

Salary Range: $100,000 - $150,000

Specific placement within the provided range will be determined by an individual’s geographic location as well as relevant experience and skills for the role. Base salary is only one component of our total compensation package. Associates may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, which is determined upon Firm and individual performance.

Responsibilities

The candidate is expected to:

- Conduct detailed analysis across the capital structure of firms

- Help screen for debt and equity investment opportunities in public and private markets

- Evaluate a firm’s business model, its competitiveness within an industry, and the industry’s long-term health and viability

- Actively monitor existing portfolio assets

- Manage processes related to investments in private securities and restructurings

- Foster and maintain relationships with company management

- Collaborate with team members responsible for both corporate and sovereign analysis

Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Additionally, the ideal candidate will possess:

- 1-5 years of investment management, investment banking, consulting or relevant industry experience

- Demonstrated interest in investing, economics, finance, politics, and/or international affairs

- Experience in financial modeling and capital structure analysis

- Experience with Microsoft Excel and exposure/interest in coding in Python, R or another language

- Foreign language skills and/or experience living, studying or working abroad, particularly in EMEA or Asia

- Strong communication skills, excellent work ethic, and a continued desire to learn

- Ability and desire to work rigorously in a highly collaborative and team-oriented environment

- Bachelor’s degree with strong academic record

jobs.title: Director of Sales – Global Special Situations
jobs.location: Boston, MA | Chicago, IL | Milwaukee, WI | San Francisco, CA | New York, NY | Denver, CO
jobs.description:
Artisan Partners’ International Value Group is seeking an experienced sales professional to expand the team’s reach into the fixed income, credit and alternatives investor universe, with an initial focus on building Global Special Situations (GSS) into a meaningful part of the group’s business. This is an opportunity to work directly with the seasoned GSS investment team at an important stage in the strategy’s development.

GSS is a flexible, catalyst-driven strategy investing globally across credit, equity and hybrid securities in public and private markets. The team focuses on high-quality businesses where corporate change, capital structure complexity or a limited natural buyer base creates mispricing. Through a concentrated portfolio of select investments, GSS pursues equity-like upside while maintaining a credit investor’s focus on downside protection.

This is a hands-on business development role for an experienced fundraiser who can originate and source new opportunities. The individual will develop new institutional relationships, identify and qualify prospective investors, and work closely with the GSS investment team to communicate the strategy and advance qualified prospects through the diligence process.

Over time, the role will support the broader $55 billion International Value Group platform, leveraging new relationships across the alternatives and fixed income universe to drive growth across GSS, International Value, International Explorer and future platform expansion capabilities.

Salary Range: $150,000 - $200,000

Specific placement within the provided range will be determined by an individual’s geographic location as well as relevant experience and skills for the role. Base salary is only one component of our total compensation package. Associates may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, which is determined based on Firm and individual performance.

Responsibilities

The candidate is expected to:

- Build and actively manage a pipeline of investors across the alternatives, credit and hedge fund universe, including family offices, multi-family offices, funds of funds, endowments and foundations, pensions, consultants and other specialist alternatives allocators.

- Originate new relationships beyond the existing IVG networks through targeted outreach, industry relationships, conferences, capital introduction networks and other business development channels.

- Leverage an existing network within the credit and alternatives community to generate high-quality introductions and prospective investor meetings.

- Execute a disciplined sales plan, identify and prioritize actionable prospects, and drive qualified opportunities through the sales process.

- Work closely with Brian Louko (portfolio manager) and Scott Bartley (Director) to develop a clear, consistent and compelling articulation of the GSS investment philosophy, process, portfolio construction, performance expectations and differentiation.

- Lead initial investor conversations and coordinate deeper investment diligence with the investment team as opportunities progress.

- Develop a strong understanding of prospective investors’ portfolios, objectives and decision-making processes to assess fit and prioritize opportunities.

- Gather and synthesize market feedback to help the team understand investor needs, recurring diligence questions and potential barriers to adoption while preserving the integrity of the investment approach.

- Partner across Artisan’s broader distribution resources to identify relationships and create relevant introductions.

- Represent GSS and, as appropriate, the broader IVG platform at relevant alternatives conferences, investor events, roadshows and other industry forums.

- Maintain disciplined pipeline management, documenting outreach, investor feedback, next steps and progression through the sales process.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Additionally, the ideal candidate will possess:

- 7+ years of sales and capital formation experience, with a demonstrated record of raising assets.

- Experience raising assets for hedge funds or other alternative strategies; experience with credit-oriented strategies is particularly relevant.

- A demonstrated track record of originating new investor relationships and raising assets, ideally for newer funds or strategies.

- An established network among institutional alternatives, credit and hedge fund investors.

- A strong new-business orientation, with demonstrated success prospecting, originating relationships and building a pipeline from the ground up.

- The ability to credibly communicate and commercialize complex investment strategies and engage in substantive conversations with sophisticated investors.

- Strong judgment regarding investor fit, relationship development and when to engage investment professionals and other senior resources.

- Strong communication, relationship-management and interpersonal skills.

- The ability to collaborate effectively with investment professionals, senior business leaders and distribution colleagues across the firm.

- Ability and willingness to travel extensively.

- FINRA Series 7 and 63 licenses required.
